title: sporadic-stakeholder-ownership-inventory-oct-2025
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, one-off inventory used to reconcile scattered ownership and short-term cost exposures for ad-hoc routing/fallbacks and temporary surge contacts. Not intended as a canonical roster — just a working table for the next 3 weeks while we triage residual tickets and handoffs.

Legend / columns:
- ID: internal row id
- Area: product/infra/ops/customer success
- Item: short descriptor
- Current owner: person owning immediate action / point of contact
- Backup: fallback contact for nights/weekends
- Priority: P0/P1/P2 (P0 = user-facing outage/latency > SLO)
- Est. burst cost (USD / 7d): quick estimate of cost if surge occurs and fallback used (e.g., dedicated fallback instances, cross-region egress)
- Region impact: NA | US | EU | APAC
- Linked ticket: Jira or internal thread
- Notes: short context / escalation rules

Rows:
1, platform, "routing: fallback-to-smaller-models", Marina Alvarez, Jordan Lee, P1, $3,200, US/EU, ENG-4129, "Fallback turned on 2025-09-12 for capacity shortage. Watch model quality regressions; contact ops if >5% quality drift over baseline set in eval run."
2, hosted-api, "embeddings: temporary cache bypass", Aisha Patel, Tomás Rivera, P2, $450, US, POPS-987, "Cache TTL temporarily reduced to 0 for debug; expect small spike in API calls. Revert when debug done."
3, customer-success, "pilot-customer: private-deploy onboarding", Tomás Rivera, Marina Alvarez, P1, $1,100, EU, CS-2043, "Customer requested region pinning; legal review pending. Short list of infra owners to loop: infra-privdeploy."
4, console, "rollout-trace: flawed sampling rule", Jordan Lee, Aisha Patel, P0, $0, US/EU, INF-6521, "Sampling rule dropped for new route; impacts SLA visibility. Immediate rollback plan signaled; requires SRE runbook activation."
5, serving-runtime, "quant-model-experiment: fallback-quantized", Marina Alvarez, Jordan Lee, P2, $600, APAC, SERV-3342, "Temporary quantized variant used for cost-test. Monitor generation variance for hallucination propensity."
6, product-ops, "feature-flag: A/B for model B", Aisha Patel, Tomás Rivera, P1, $750, US, FF-7781, "Canary at 10% currently; owners to confirm rollback criteria by EOD +3d."

Quick rollup (back-of-envelope):
- Total short-window estimated exposure (7d): $6,100
- P0 items: 1 (console rollout-trace) — immediate SRE attention required
- P1 items: 3 — owners lined up, confirm runbooks and SSOs
- P2 items: 2 — monitor and reconvene next weekly triage

Assumptions / constraints:
- Estimates are guestimates for immediate triage; cost model uses past week token/instance burn rates and conservative egress multipliers.
- Some items reference tickets that are already in progress; this sheet is to reduce confusion and speed handoffs across shifts.

Unresolved questions:
- Who owns long-term remediation for the routing fallback (product or platform)? (action: assign by 2025-10-05)
- Legal/compliance sign-off timeline for private-deploy pilot in EU — we need a concrete date to avoid customer SLA slips.
- Are weekend backups adequate (on-call vs on-call-rotation)? If not, escalate to SRE manager.

Action items (short):
- Marina: confirm SRE runbook activation for row 4 and post link in ENG-4129 (due 2025-09-18).
- Jordan: validate rollback metrics threshold and add alert to Datadog (due 2025-09-19).
- Aisha: revert cache TTL after debug session ends and note actual delta in cost column (ongoing).
- Tomás: chase legal for private-deploy checklist and put expected sign-off date in ticket CS-2043 (due 2025-09-23).

Notes to self / ephemeral logs:
- 2025-09-17 09:12 — quick call with SRE on rollback cadence; they asked for spike window samples
- 2025-09-18 14:40 — Aisha verified cache bypass; incremental requests +12% YOY for the debug window
- 2025-09-20 11:05 — agreed to reconvene triage on 2025-09-24; owners to post short status updates beforehand

If you are added as an owner while you are not the correct long-term responsible party: add yourself as "Current owner" and mark the Notes with "temp-owner" and nominate the expected long-term owner (helps when we rotate people).

End of sheet.
notes_summary: Lightweight 6-row tracker to reconcile temporary ownership and near-term cost exposure for ad-hoc fallbacks and small pilot rollouts. For 3-week triage horizon.
